title: The Selmer converse for elliptic curves at every prime

issues.location: Sections 4-8 and Appendix (theta construction, constant terms, cusp lifting, GU(3,1) Galois parameters, nonstandard transfer), build/sections/04-08, 10-nonstandard-transfer.tex
issues.description: This is not a demonstrated error. The automorphic half of the argument is too compressed to check line by line. That covers the uniform integral moment estimates, the bounded-content Fourier-Jacobi coefficient, cusp lifting on the ordinary locus of the PEL variety, Lemma two-contacts, and the change-of-characteristic transfer. The contradiction depends entirely on the Hecke congruence (eq:reduced-hecke-congruence) that these sections produce, so the correctness of the main theorem rests on parts this audit could not verify.
issues.evidence: Prop. cusp-congruence / Prop. nilpotent-control supply lambda_i : T_i -> O/(p^{M_i})[t]/(t^{b_*}), used as the sole input to Sec. 9

coverage: I read the README, main.tex, and Sections 1, 2, 3, 9 and 10 (Sylvester) in full, plus the Hecke-algebra and congruence parts of Sections 7 and 8. Checks made: (1) Lemma auxiliary-fields: the splitting conditions, the Jacobi symbol (D/|D'|)=1 via chi_D(m)=(m/|D|), disc(L)=disc(F)^2 giving L/F unramified, and roots of unity. (2) Prop. arithmetic-reduction: the twist root numbers w(A^D)=w(A^{D'})=-(-1)^r and w(A^{DD'})=(-1)^r, the decomposition of H^1_f over K into the two twists, the dimension count 1 and 1, and the Gross-Zagier step giving a(A_0)=r. (3) Lemma base-green: the symmetric local pairing and hyperbolic plane, the annihilator argument, and the skew-symmetric graph matrix forced to zero by c-equivariance (c preserves local invariants). (4) The obstruction pairing H_gamma: symmetry and conjugation antisymmetry giving the matrix [[0,k],[-k,0]], and the Heisenberg commutator refinement (u(gamma sigma^m)=u(gamma)+m u(sigma), with translations and radicals unchanged). (5) Prop. green-length: the induction showing H^1 = t^{b-1}(base), so the length is at most 2. (6) Prop. heegner-log: the split norm relation, trace=(a_q-2)y, and the Fricke sign +1 when r=1, giving z_1^c=-z_1, then z_2 in the locally-zero line. (7) Sec. 9: the cyclotomic corner killed by unit rank 1 of the CM biquadratic L plus the injectivity of the p-adic log, the weight-sum argument (generic unitary bound gives w=3 against residual y=eps^{-2} with weight 4, so the corner is a unit), and Fitting ideal 0 implying length at least b. (8) Sec. 10: the Satge models (27*(4l)^2=432 l^2), rank = dim S + dim S' - 1 - a - b (one rational 3-torsion point in ker lambda'), dim Sha[3] <= a+b, s_3 <= 1, and root number -1. All of these were consistent. I did not verify Sections 4-8 or the appendix in detail.
main_claim: For every elliptic curve A_0/Q, every prime p, and r in {0,1}: if the Z_p-corank of Sel_{p^infty}(A_0/Q) is r, then the analytic rank and the Mordell-Weil rank both equal r and Sha(A_0/Q) is finite. Corollary: every prime l = 4, 7 or 8 mod 9 is a sum of two rational cubes, and E_l has rank 1.
sibling_notes: On the family-002 board, the rank-7 (Two-primary BSD) and rank-11 (Exact BSD) branches both reported no_gap_found with partial audits. They found no circularity between the companions and the Goldfeld paper. I checked this independently: the Goldfeld density / 2-converse paper (OpenAIGoldfeldDensity2026) cites this paper only as 'a subsequent companion' and does not use it, so this paper's reliance on that paper's Theorems 1.1 and 1.2 (the 2-converse and twist density) is not circular. That dependency is the only cross-paper input, and its soundness rests on the companion's own audit.
